rules: Never accept actor or reviewer identity from request payloads.
Every authorization decision must include tenantId, userId, roles, permission, resource, and result.
Cross-tenant access requires platform_admin and an audited break-glass event.
separationOfDuties: Requester cannot approve the same task.
QA reviewer cannot provide human approval for the same task.
Human approver cannot provide deployment approval for the same task.
Critical-task approvals require distinct verified users.
